programme.title: Trap
programme.desc: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert.

programme.title: Epic
programme.desc: Magically transported to a secret realm, a teenage girl (Amanda Seyfried) joins an ongoing battle between the forces of good, which keep the natural world vital, and the forces of evil, which want to destroy it.

programme.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band
programme.desc: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era.

programme.title: Colette
programme.desc: After moving to Paris, author Sidonie-Gabrielle Colette agrees to ghostwrite a semi-autobiographical novel for her husband. Its success soon inspires her to fight for creative ownership and overcome the societal constraints of the early 20th century.

programme.title: Miss Sloane
programme.desc: A cutthroat Washington, D.C., lobbyist (Jessica Chastain) makes powerful new enemies by supporting a bill that imposes regulations on the sale of firearms.

programme.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri

programme.title: Spring Breakers
programme.desc: Four college friends (Vanessa Hudgens, Selena Gomez, Ashley Benson, Rachel Korine) are arrested after robbing a restaurant to fund their spring-break trip. They land in more trouble when a drug and arms dealer bails them out to do some dirty work.

programme.title: Lady Bird
programme.desc: A teenager (Saoirse Ronan) navigates a loving but turbulent relationship with her strong-willed mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of an eventful and poignant senior year of high school.

programme.title: Life of Pi
programme.desc: After the freighter they're on sinks in a storm, a teenager (Suraj Sharma) and a Bengal tiger wind up on a small lifeboat and must learn to trust each other to survive.

programme.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
programme.desc: When his boss (John Tormey) turns against him, a hit man (Forest Whitaker) who lives like a samurai must fend for his life.

programme.title: Hall Pass
programme.desc: Rick and Fred, two husbands who are having difficulty in their marriages, are given a Hall Pass by their wives for one week, they can do whatever they want.

programme.title: MacGruber
programme.desc: After his sworn enemy steals a nuclear warhead, a clueless soldier-of-fortune (Will Forte) leads a skilled team on a mission to retrieve the device and bring the thief to justice.

programme.title: The Player
programme.desc: About 65 real-life movie stars fringe the satire of a Hollywood studio executive (Tim Robbins) who gets away with murder.

programme.title: Aftermath
programme.desc: Two strangers' lives become inextricably bound together after an error by an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy) causes the death of a construction foreman's (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wife and daughter.

programme.title: Aftermath

programme.title: Chasing Mavericks
programme.desc: Hearing that the mythic Mavericks surf break is real, a teenage surfer (Jonny Weston) asks a local legend (Gerard Butler) to teach him how to ride the wave and live to tell the tale.

programme.title: Brian Banks
programme.desc: The true story of Brian Banks, a high school football player who faces prison for a crime he didn't commit. Years later, with the support of the California Innocence Project, Banks fights to reclaim his life and fulfill his dreams of NFL stardom.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Partnered with a mysterious stranger (Dave Franco), a high school senior (Emma Roberts) joins a popular online game that dares players to perform increasingly dangerous stunts.

programme.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
programme.desc: Twentieth-century teenagers (Leonardo DiCaprio, Claire Danes) fall in love, despite feuding families, in an update of the classic tragedy.

programme.title: The Switch

programme.title: A History of Violence

programme.title: Solace
programme.desc: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer.

programme.title: Batman

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) clashes with Catwoman (Michelle Pfeiffer) and saves gloomy Gotham City from the foul Penguin's (Danny DeVito) plot.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: The Caped Crusader (Val Kilmer) woos a criminal psychologist, takes on a sidekick and battles Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones) and the Riddler (Jim Carrey).

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Batgirl joins the caped crusaders (George Clooney, Chris O'Donnell) to stop Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger) and Poison Ivy from wreaking revenge upon the world.

programme.title: Inconceivable

programme.title: Hitchcock
programme.desc: Alma Reville lends her customary support to husband Alfred Hitchcock as he directs "Psycho," but her reservations about the film's production cause a strain in their marriage.

programme.title: Architecton

programme.title: The Internship

programme.title: The Way, Way Back
programme.desc: After his mother's lover (Steve Carell) belittles him, a boy (Liam James) befriends a water-park employee (Sam Rockwell) who helps give him the confidence to come out of his shell.

programme.title: The Flash

programme.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.

programme.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes

programme.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes

programme.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: A ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson) leads his troops in a deadly battle against Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his army of intelligent apes.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes

programme.title: Contagion

programme.title: Repo Men
